events.description:
**Not recommended – use `onPress` instead.** `onClick` is an alias for `onPress`
provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.
events.name: onClick

events.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

events.description: Handler that is called when the hover state changes.

events.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction ends.

events.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction starts.

events.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either

Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

props.description: The text (or content) of the link; a link without text needs `label`.
props.name: children

props.description: Where the link goes: an app path (`/orders/ord_1`) for the router, or an absolute URL (`https:`, `mailto:`).
props.name: href

props.description: Whether the link is inert: not focusable, not pressable, announced as disabled. Defaults to false.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: Whether the link leaves the app: a new tab on web, the system browser on native, with the external mark.
props.name: isExternal

props.description: The semantic colour of the link text. Defaults to `default`, the theme's link colour.
props.name: tone

props.description: When the underline shows: `always` (default; required inside running text) or `hover` (standalone links).
props.name: underline

props.description: The accessible name when the visible content is not text (an icon-only link), or must be more specific.
props.name: label

props.description: What assistive technology hears for an external link. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: externalLabel

props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render
props.name: autoFocus

props.description: Custom classes merged with the default styles
props.name: className

props.description: Prompts file download instead of navigation
props.name: download

props.description: Relationship between the current and linked documents
props.name: rel

props.description: Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
props.name: render
props.type: (props: DetailedHTMLProps<LinkWithRequiredHref, HTMLAnchorElement> | DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, renderProps: LinkRenderProps) => ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>

props.name: target

props.description:
Indicates whether this element represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.
props.name: aria-current

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description:
Hints at the human language of the linked URL.
See[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#hreflang).
props.name: hrefLang

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
A space-separated list of URLs to ping when the link is followed. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#ping).
props.name: ping

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description:
How much of the referrer to send when following the link. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#referrerpolicy).
props.name: referrerPolicy

props.description: Options for the configured client side router.
props.name: routerOptions

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.
props.name: style
